t: Deta TTE oval 16mm conduit clips are robust fittings designed for securely mounting rigid oval conduit. Manufactured from high impact, heavy gauge uPVC, these clips offer exceptional durability and long-lasting performance for electrical installations. They are ideal for electricians and trade professionals requiring a reliable solution for surface wiring in various environments, including workshops and utility rooms. The 16mm oval design ensures a precise fit, helping to maintain an organised and professional conduit system.
